IV rank (52-week, CBOE) is under 15 on 9 of 12 names. Only SMCI (39), PURR (39) and PSKY (60) sit higher.
Four of 12 quotes are wide: PURR, PSKY, RDW and CORZ. RDW (131) and CORZ (89) also have under 200 OI at the strike.
TMPro has SMCI reporting Nov 3, inside its Nov 6 expiry. That calendar ends Nov 4, so the Nov 6 expiries on SMR and SOUN are not cleared either.
